On 24 December 2025 at 9.00 hrs., in the Ratchadamnoen Room, Royal Princess Hotel Lan Luang, Bangkok, Professor Emeritus Dr. Suraphon Itsarakraisin, President of the Royal Society of Thailand, opened the academic forum on “Revered Fellows of the Royal Society, Sages of the Land No. 14” and the brainstorming session on the Royal Society’s 5-Year Strategy No. 3, on the occasion of the Royal Society’s 100th anniversary. Dr. Supharoek Phuphongsak, Secretary-General of the Royal Society of Thailand, delivered the report. A total of 147 participants attended, including Fellows, Associate Fellows, executives and staff of the Office of the Royal Society, and speakers who are descendants and students of the revered Fellows.
